items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: No, he played with a Sam Morgan band all the time. He traveled with them and all. That was Sam Morgan's drummer, Royal.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I don't remember him.

No, he played with a Sam Morgan band all the time. He traveled with them and all. That was Sam Morgan's drummer, Royal. Oh yeah. Yeah. And he had another drummer he knew before I knew Royal, but this fella did and I don't know his name, see? Because I wasn't playing no drums then. But I went around while they was. I was, but I don't know this fella there. He was a nice drummer.
I was going to ask again about your brother. You say your brother helped you along to show you drums when you started? Or?
